text:
ana: Heads-up — noticed a step-drop in observed batch_utilization and tokens/sec right after yesterday's kernel-selector rollout. Queue depth climbed from ~12 -> ~45 on p99 for small models.

matt: ugh. was the rollout the one that changed kernel heuristics for attn-tile sizes?

ana: yes, we flipped the kernel_selector to prefer tiled kernels for seq<=256 to save compute. metric delta kicked in ~03:12 UTC.

jin: if tiled kernels reduced per-request latency but increased variance, that can break batching heuristics. batching window might be closing early.

sam: can you paste the graphs/queries? want to see raw signals.

ana: here's the basic PromQL I used (quick):
```
sum(rate(runtime_batch_tokens_total[1m])) by (model) / max(1, sum(runtime_batch_slots_available) by (model))
```
not perfect but shows tokens/sec per slot. attached a screenshot in thread.

lee: also see KV cache hit rate dropped from 98% -> 86% around same time in the traces. maybe kernel change affected cache alignments / evictions.

batching-bot: deploy event: kernel-selector v2.3 rolled to prod at 1976529300 by ci/cd.

ana: action suggestion: 1) add a dashboard panel for Batch Utilization (p50/p95) by model family, 2) Queue depth heatmap, 3) Tokens/sec per GPU, 4) KV cache hit rate + evictions. make short-term revert plan if utilization doesn't recover in 2 hours.

matt: +1. Also add a panel that correlates chosen kernel variant (label kernel=...) with batch_size distribution — if tiled kernels correlate with many 1-2 sized batches that's the smoking gun.

jin: I can instrument a per-request label in the runtime: `kernel.variant` and `batch.formed_size`. will emit to metrics and traces. will post PR in 10m.

sam: I'll run a canary with `kernel_selector.prefer_tiled=false` for models with avg seq<=256 and watch batch_utilization. sam -> i'll spin up canary now.

ana: for dashboard queries, drafts:
- Batch util (p95): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_batch_util_bucket[1m])) by (le, model))`
- Queue depth (heatmap): `sum(runtime_queue_depth) by (model, zone)`
- Tokens/sec per GPU: `sum(rate(runtime_tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (gpu_id)`
- KV cache hit rate: `sum(increase(kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(increase(kv_cache_lookups[5m]))`

lee: nice. can we also add an alert if batch_utilization_p95 < 0.25 for >5m for any model? that would catch regressions fast.

ana: yes — set alert severity=page for paid-tier models, warn for internal ones.

jin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/642 — adds `kernel.variant` and `batch.size` labels to metrics. exposing as counter `runtime_batch_formed_total{kernel_variant, batch_size}`.

sam: canary running: `canary/kernel-select-fallback-1976543210` up. initial metrics: batch_util p95 moved 0.12 -> 0.34 after fallback on canary hosts. keeping an eye.

matt: great. once jin's labels land we can do a simple group_by in the dashboard to prove correlation.

ana: next steps: jin to merge instrumentation, matt to add dashboard panels (start with templated model selector), sam to run broader fallback if canary holds for 30m, lee to propose alert thresholds. I'll file a short postmortem if this needs a revert.

deploy-bot: canary health: all checks OK (10/10) for canary group.

ana: thanks team. keep updates here — if anyone sees KV eviction spikes please ping immediately and include trace ids. :thumbsup:
